description:
Process Concept: **Point Cloud Processing**.

> Operations on point clouds: converting them to other kinds of data (grids, feature collections) and reducing them (thinning) -- independent of any input/output signature or implementation (OGC 14-065 WPS 2.0.2 §7.5.1).

## Source

- [OGC 17-030r1 LAS Specification 1.4 OGC Community Standard](https://www.ogc.org/standards/las/)
- [SAGA 7.3.0 tool library Shapes - Point Clouds](https://saga-gis.sourceforge.io/saga_tool_doc/7.3.0/pointcloud_tools.html)

## Relations

- Broader concept of (`broader`): [`point-cloud-rasterization`](../../generic-profile/point-cloud-rasterization/), [`point-cloud-thinning`](../../generic-profile/point-cloud-thinning/), [`point-cloud-to-features`](../../generic-profile/point-cloud-to-features/)

## Register position

Top tier of the four-tier model (OGC 14-065 WPS 2.0.2 §7.5): **Concept** -> Generic Profile ->
Implementation Profile -> Implementation (instance level).
